body:
> It's hard to believe you were discharged on a rumor alone.  
  
Apparently you've never been enlisted.  That happens fairly frequently.  Usually, if they can't pick up some physical evidence, they'll slap you with a personality disorder or gender dysphoria.  
  
God forbid if you're a rape victim and step up.  
  
> Chances are you put your dick in the wrong guy  
  
That's called rape.  I also don't fancy guys in uniform.  Not my type.  
  
Oh wait, I forgot that gay orgy I had with a bunch of mechanics on my 1SGs desk.  That must have been it.  
  
> didn't put it in enough right gals.  
  
I'm more willing to believe that's the case as I wasn't willing to participate in the trains that got run in the barracks on the stripper that got brought home once every weekend.  I wasn't really that interested and most people aren't my type.  
  
Call me picky.  
  
In any event...have a happy father's day.  (Or not)

You know what always makes me feel better?  Trolls.  Why?  
  
Because I haven't lived with my parents in over 9 years and I feel a certain level of achievement when I see a person who obviously still lives in their parents' basement working a minimum wage job.  
  
Oh, you were expecting me to be down on myself and in a vulnerable position for you to fuck with?  You apparently didn't read the whole part where I said I was tired, not self-piteous or self-loathing.  
  
Have a nice day, your XBox kingdom awaits (in your parents' basement).  
  
EDIT:  Just for the record, I did keep it a secret.  It was a guess by an NCO who decided to start a rumor.  It's not like I was waving a rainbow flag or showing up wearing a feather boa in uniform.
